description_en: Retrieves complete metadata for a table, including field details
description_zh: 获取表的完整信息（包括字段信息）
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public get-meta-table-full-info --table-guid odps.engine_name.table_name --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id C-010A704DA7600000 --database-name abc --table-name abc --data-source-type emr --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMetaTableFullInfo

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173916.html operation to query the unique identifier of the table
parameters.help_zh: 表的唯一标识。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173916.html，获取表的唯一标识
parameters.name: table_guid

parameters.help_en: The page number requested for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 请求获取的页码数，用于分页
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of items per page, with a default of 10 and a maximum of 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the EMR cluster. This parameter is required only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to emr.

You can log on to the [EMR console](https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou) to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
EMR集群的ID，仅当数据类型为EMR时，需要配置该参数。

您可以登录[EMR的控制台](https://emr.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.965cc5c2GeiHet#/cn-hangzhou)，获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. This parameter is required only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to emr.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185662.html operation to query the database name
parameters.help_zh:
数据库的名称。仅当数据类型为EMR时，需要配置该参数。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185662.html接口获取
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the table in the EMR cluster. This parameter is required only if you set the DataSourceType parameter to emr.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173916.html operation to query the table name
parameters.help_zh:
EMR的表名称。仅当数据类型为EMR时，需要配置该参数。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173916.html接口，获取表名称
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. Set the value to emr
parameters.help_zh: 数据类型，当前仅支持取值为EMR
parameters.name: data_source_type
